_comment: What MyScribe knows about offering Ollama that is not a release (ADR-017, ADR-021 Proposed; TASK-089.18, TASK-095). The release itself is not here: since TASK-095 the offer asks GitHub for Ollama's newest release (the latest-release endpoint of the API, which skips drafts and prereleases; scribe/ollama_setup.py, LATEST_API) when it is built, and takes the URL, the size and the sha256 of this platform's asset from that answer. The download must then match both the API's digest and the release's own sha256sum.txt, and on Windows the signer below. What stays here is what does not change from one release to the next: the asset's name, the installer's flags, the signer, where it installs, the model sizes and the vendor page every failure ends on. Under scribe/ because the payload ships scribe/ and not packaging/ (packaging/build_payload.py APP_PATHS).

win32.name: OllamaSetup.exe
notes: The flags are install.ps1:271 of release v0.34.3's own install.ps1 (sha256 2960b27506320691d983429d905f144898c59cf8c9390c8622af7a0bf313c30d, 22,627 bytes), read on 2026-09-23. docs.ollama.com/windows (read 2026-09-23) documents no silent flags, so the flags rest on that script alone. A newer release is assumed to take the same flags; that is unverified, and an installer that does not would end with a non-zero exit code and no marker.

The signer rule is install.ps1:84-87 of the same script: the subject must carry O=Ollama Inc., anchored so that O=Not Ollama Inc. does not pass. Read once, on 2026-09-26, on the v0.34.3 installer (1,570,198,936 bytes, sha256 fe1cce21...ee3a0) with this module's own verify_signer: status Valid, subject CN=Ollama Inc., O=Ollama Inc., L=Toronto, S=Ontario, C=CA. A later release signed differently fails safe and ends on the vendor page.

The install folder is install.ps1:118 and docs.ollama.com/windows (read 2026-09-23: 'installs in your account without requiring Administrator rights', 'at least 4GB of space for the binary install'). The same page says the installer keeps Ollama up to date afterwards, and docs.ollama.com/faq (same day) says Ollama on macOS and Windows downloads its updates automatically.

darwin.name: Ollama.dmg
notes: Guided, and unverified on a real Mac (ADR-017, Exceptions): MyScribe downloads and checks the image, opens it with `open`, and waits with Check again while the person drags Ollama into Applications and starts it. No marker is written, because no installer process finishes here for MyScribe to see.
The folder is install.sh:66-83 as read on 2026-09-20; nobody here has a Mac.

linux.name: install.sh
notes: MyScribe runs nothing on Linux: the script needs root or sudo (install.sh:110-118), removes an existing library directory (install.sh:164-167) and can install graphics drivers (install.sh:353, :381), all as read on 2026-09-20. A yes shows four commands - download the release's install.sh, check its sha256 against the figure the offer fetched, read it, run it - and the person runs them and presses Check again.

UNVERIFIED: the tarball the script then downloads is Ollama's choice on the day it runs; docs.ollama.com/linux (read 2026-09-23) says the script does not install GPU drivers, while the script read on 2026-09-20 has driver-install branches - a conflict reported, not resolved. Nobody here has run this path (TASK-089.18 criterion 16, Robert's WSL).

qwen3.5:4b.note: The default. The size is what the Ollama on the reference machine reported for it on /api/tags on 2026-09-20 and again on 2026-09-23 (read only). It is the model that provably answered here on 2026-09-02, and it fits beside whatever else holds video memory (scribe/llm/ollama.py, default_model).

gemma4:12b.note: Listed only on a CUDA card reporting at least 23,622,320,128 bytes (22 GiB) and never on Apple Silicon: an estimate modelled on one measured card (scribe/ollama_setup.py, GEMMA_THRESHOLD_BYTES). The size is the reference machine's /api/tags figure, read the same two days.
